borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

  • Site Location Plan and Block Plan (drawin ref: 100, dated: 06/12/2024)
  • Proposed Block Plan (drawing: 200, revision: A, dated: 11/11/2025)
  • Proposed Floor Plans (drawing ref: 201, revision: B, dated: 11/11/2025)
  • Proposed Front and Rear Elevations (drawing ref: 202, revision: A, dated: 11/11/2025)
  • Proposed Side Elevation and Section (drawing ref: 203, revision: A, dated: 07/10/2025)

Other documents:

  • Design and Access Statement (dated: June 2025)
  • Urban Greening Factor Statement (received: 28/08/2025)
  • Parking stress survey (dated: November 2025)

No other drawings or documents apply.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing dwellinghouse.

Cycle Storage (a)  Prior to first occupation, details including the design and location of all cycle parking spaces shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. All cycle storage should be designed and laid out in accordance with the guidance contained in the London Cycling Design Standards. (b)  The approved details shall be implemented prior to first use of the development and thereafter permanently retained for the lifetime of the development.

Refuse Storage(a)  Prior to first occupation, details including the quantum, design and location of the refuse storage shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. (b)  The approved details shall be implemented prior to first use of the development and thereafter permanently retained for the lifetime of the development.
description: Conversion of the garage into a habitable room including the replacement of the shutter door with a window, construction of a first floor side extension, a single storey rear extension, and a rear dormer extension including two roof lights to the front and a Juliette balcony and conversion of the dwelling into 3no. flats (1x 3bed and 2x 1 bed) including the addition of one entrance door to the front elevation and one to the side, and the installation of a boundary fence
